title: GenerationPin
description: A session holding on to a generation: kept near, so it is found again. An edge and not a column, because being pinned is not a property of the generation — the same generation is pinned in one session and not in another, and a column would make one session's opinion look like the thing's own.

id.description: The record's own id in the system that holds it.

generation.description: The generation being held on to, by its id in the system that holds it.

session.description: The working session holding on to it, by that session's id in the system that holds it. That a session pins a generation at most once is the pinning system's rule, not a constraint of this shape.
